args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, add the product CYLINDER and select CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB so Product Variant becomes Default Variant; enter Quantity Requested 10, select Plant Name (LOC-0001) for Delivery location, open Savings, choose Budget, leave the price empty, save, and stop when the screen shows the refusal Please enter price in INR.
